digest.component_or_area: LLM completion verification / structured output parsing
propositions: The completion verifier returns a schema-invalid Dep (dependency-link) record instead of a CompletionVerdict when the model quotes a dep record in prose before emitting a valid fenced verdict, causing fail-closed rejection.

tolerant_parse selects the first *parseable* JSON object rather than the first *schema-valid* object, and _FENCE_RE prioritizes fenced blocks, allowing quoted deps in tool results to be selected over the intended verdict.

A schema-filtered candidate selection layer in parse_structured must enumerate all fenced blocks and top-level objects, screen by key-overlap against model_cls.model_fields (rejecting zero-overlap junk), validate each survivor, and select the last valid candidate with ambiguity warnings.

The defect is architectural—a typed payload recovered from an untyped channel by positional heuristics—not a wiring error; the selection policy is deliberate and shared by all LLM gates, so any fix requires atomically shipping a sentinel directive change alongside extraction logic.

E1–E4 experiments prove NativeOutput+thinking is wire-viable on Bedrock sonnet-4-6/haiku-4-5 but tools+thinking+native causes tool skipping, keeping the verifier on the prompted path; sentinel markers + last-valid-wins recovers all five historical failure layouts; all existing tests pass with the prototype injected.
